WITH bucket_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) as bucket_count
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
all_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(bucket_count) as total_count,
    1.0 / COUNT(*) as avg_share
  FROM bucket_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    bc.timespan,
    bc.bucket_count,
    CAST(bc.bucket_count AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / all_stats.total_count as share,
    all_stats.avg_share
  FROM bucket_counts bc
  CROSS JOIN all_stats
),
kept_buckets AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan,
    bucket_count,
    share,
    avg_share
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(bucket_count) as total_count_kept,
  AVG(share) as avg_share_kept,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess
FROM kept_buckets;

assumptions.assumption: At least one matching pair exists between riskandmargin and orders; otherwise 1.0 / COUNT(*) causes division by zero when computing the average share of all buckets.
orders.recordvault is unique or appropriate as the basis for counting distinct orders, per the foreign key references in fees and riskandmargin tables.
